settings.heading: Dates and numbers
settings.reload: The page reloads to apply a change.

admin.calendar_help: Every date on the forum is shown in this calendar, including relative times, tooltips and date pickers, in core and in other extensions. Dates are still stored as Gregorian/UTC.
admin.numerals_help: The digits used for dates, times, counts and other interface numbers. Posts, titles and code are never changed.
admin.second_calendar_help: Optional. Adds the date in this calendar to every date's tooltip.
admin.member_choice_help: Adds "Dates and numbers" to each member's settings. A member who keeps the forum's choice follows yours.
admin.fallback: This browser can't show that calendar or those digits. It shows Gregorian dates or Western digits instead, and so will any visitor's browser that lacks them.
admin.jalali_calendar_notice: Jalali Calendar (mabioca/jalali-calendar) is also enabled. Astrolabe covers what it does, so don't run both.

api.unknown_system: Choose one of the listed calendars or digits.
